comment: Glyphcraft. Aether shards, mined from aether stone, are inscribed at a shrine into that shrine's glyphs, all at once. Each glyph needs a Glyphcraft level and gives xp per shard. At every multiple of `every` levels (from `every` itself) each shard makes one more glyph. The shrine's glyph comes from the name of the area it stands in ("Wind Shrine").
